item.title: Refactor orders: OrderStatus enum replaces status strings
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim, authenticated local socket): "The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type:

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit your work."

Constraints: the crate is at the root of this item's worktree. Before changing anything, read the existing status handling and confirm current behaviour (report output, ordering, error messages, parsing) so it stays identical. Keep functions under 60 lines and keep comments minimal. Commit only with the configured git identity; do not override it and do not add any attribution line that names Claude, Claude Code, or any tool.

stages.summary: Refactored the orders crate to use an OrderStatus enum in place of status strings. Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus (as_str, Display, FromStr, can_transition_to) and ParseStatusError (std::error::Error). Order::status is now OrderStatus; OrderStatus and ParseStatusError are re-exported from the crate root. Status literals appear only in src/status.rs. Public API change: Order.status type, and report::status_counts now returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)> sorted by status name as before. Verified against a temporary characterization test run before and after (removed afterwards): report order, CSV lines, parse errors, refusal messages and totals are identical. Checks on head 78871dd: cargo fmt --check clean, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test passes (3 integration, 3 unit). Review: agt_01M8APXDTVHZS1R168HY4DDMM2 passed the head with no blocking findings. Open follow-up (non-blocking): from_line's unknown-status message is not asserted through from_line, only in the ParseStatusError unit test. Nothing was pushed, and no processes were started. Review: pass.

pr.body: Approach: add src/status.rs (OrderStatus, ParseStatusError). Order::status and billing/shipping/report use the enum. Lifecycle rules live in can_transition_to. status_counts keys by as_str() to keep the alphabetical report order. from_line uses ParseStatusError's Display, which yields the same 'unknown status {:?}' text as before. Key files: src/status.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/orders.rs. Checks: fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test all pass. Characterization before/after matched for report output, CSV lines, parse errors, refusal messages and totals. Assumptions: the Order.status type and status_counts return type are intentional API changes. Open follow-up (non-blocking): assert from_line's unknown-status message in tests/orders.rs.
